service.method: SELECT USER_VIEW.USER_ID , USER_VIEW.USER_NM AS USER_NAME_LOC , USER_VIEW.DEPT_CD AS DEPT , USER_VIEW.TEAM_CD AS TEAM , USER_VIEW.PSTN_CD AS POSITION , USER_VIEW.EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL , USER_VIEW.MBL_TNO AS PHONE , USER_VIEW.WRK_STAT_CD , DEPT_VIEW.DEPT_NM AS COMPANY_NAME_LOC FROM COA.TB_CO1017M_USERINFO USER_VIEW INNER JOIN COA.TB_CO1018M_DEPTINFO DEPT_VIEW ON USER_VIEW.DEPT_CD = DEPT_VIEW.DEPT_CD WHERE USER_VIEW.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND USER_VIEW.CLPO_CD <> '88' AND USER_VIEW.WRK_STAT_CD <> '09' AND USER_VIEW.DEPT_CD NOT LIKE 'P%' -- WRK_STAT_CD : 01(재직), 04(휴직), 07(파견), 09(퇴직)

INSERT INTO SUSMT ( HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , PLANT_CODE , USER_NAME_LOC , USER_NAME_ENG , PASSWORD , DEPT , POSITION , EMAIL , COUNTRY , SIGN_STATUS , WORK_TYPE , MENU_PROFILE_CODE , USER_TYPE , PASS_CHECK_CNT , PW_RESET_FLAG , DEL_FLAG , DATE_FORMAT , PHONE , LANGUAGE , EMPLOYEE_NO ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE} , ${session.COMPANY_CODE} , ${USER_ID} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID} , ${session.COMPANY_CODE} , ${USER_NAME_LOC} , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${USER_NAME_ENG}, USER_NAME_ENG) , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${PASSWORD}, PASSWORD) , ${DEPT} , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${POSITION}, POSITION) , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${EMAIL}, EMAIL) , 'KR' , 'A' , 'G' , ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE} , 'A' , '0' , 'N' , 'N' , '%Y/%m/%d' , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${PHONE},PHONE) , 'KO' , #DB_OWNER#NVL(${EMPLOYEE_NO}, EMPLOYEE_NO) )
